text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite periods of no trading; frequent action is not necessary when price changes are unpredictable.","Selling Stock A, D, and E after sizable gains felt rewarding, but gains alone do not show that selling was the best choice; I should base trades on my plan and future prospects.","I should review my holdings periodically and make deliberate decisions, rather than let my discomfort with realizing losses or desire to lock in gains drive trades."]}
